kind: multi-agent: independent modules plus a shared dependency
title: Three string helpers and an index
idea: Add three independent string helpers, each in its own file with its own test file: src/vowels.js (countVowels(s) counts a, e, i, o, u in any case), src/reverse.js (reverseWords(s) reverses the order of space-separated words), src/caps.js (capitalize(s) upper-cases the first letter and lower-cases the rest). Then add src/index.js re-exporting all three, and a 'Helpers' section in README.md that names each function. npm test must run every test file and pass.

acceptance.name: the three helpers and the index work
each helper has its own test file and npm test passes
acceptance.command: test -s test/vowels.test.js && test -s test/reverse.test.js && test -s test/caps.test.js && npm test
